purpose: Provenance registry for the 취업정보 신고용 직종·업종 analyzer. Records every source the analyzer's classification, legal/reporting rules, vocabulary and test prioritization rest on, with reliability and usage so nothing is hallucinated. Canonical codes live in data/jobcode_master.json; this file never contains codes.

reliability_levels.statistics: Aggregate immigrant/employment statistics — used ONLY to prioritize coverage and tests, never as classification truth.

sources.title: 법무부 「외국인 취업정보 온라인 신고제」 보도자료 / 안내
sources.title_en: Ministry of Justice — Foreigner Employment Information Online Reporting (press release / overview)
sources.reliability_notes: Primary reference for reporting items (직종·업종·소득), reporting target statuses, F-5 exclusion, 15-day change deadline, and the HiKorea visit-reservation / e-civil-petition flows. Facts are mirrored into data/jobcode_master.json#employment_reporting_context and data/employment/visa_reporting_scope.json.
sources.limitations: Binary HWPX (not machine-rendered here); facts were transcribed into structured data. Exact wording must be re-checked against the live HiKorea screens before final reporting.

sources.title: HiKorea 취업정보 신고 절차 안내(방문예약/전자민원)
sources.title_en: HiKorea employment-reporting procedure (visit reservation / e-civil petition)
sources.reliability_notes: Primary product-behavior reference: occupation (직종명 검색) and industry (업종명 검색) are searched separately; results show 국가데이터처 표준직업/표준산업분류 lists. Drives the two-track candidate UI.
sources.limitations: Screen layout may change; income-bracket labels and dropdown contents must be confirmed live.

sources.title: HiKorea 취업정보 신고 FAQ
sources.reliability_notes: FAQ confirms 직종명/업종명 검색 lists are based on the 국가데이터처 표준분류 and can be checked on the 통계분류포털 (Q7).
sources.limitations: FAQ is guidance, not the legal text; defer to 출입국관리법 시행규칙 for binding rules.

sources.title: 제8차 한국표준직업분류 (KSCO8)
sources.title_en: Korean Standard Classification of Occupations, 8th rev. (KSCO8)
sources.reliability_notes: PRIMARY occupation (직종) classification source. 통계청 고시 제2024-328호, 공고 2024-07-01, 시행 2025-01-01. Canonical rows in data/jobcode_master.json (type=occupation). HiKorea 직종명 검색 is based on this 국가데이터처 표준직업분류.
sources.limitations: Runtime carries 대/중/소/세분류; KSCO8 세세분류(5단계) 전체표 not fully loaded — deepest codes must be confirmed on HiKorea / 통계분류포털.

sources.title: 제11차 한국표준산업분류 (KSIC11)
sources.reliability_notes: PRIMARY industry (업종) classification source. 통계청 고시 제2024-2호(부칙개정 제2024-203호), 시행 2024-07-01. Full 2,038-row table loaded into data/jobcode_master.json (type=industry). HiKorea 업종명 검색 is based on this 국가데이터처 표준산업분류.
sources.limitations: Industry of an employee is the employer's primary business, not the worker's task — handled by the occupation/industry split.

sources.title: 국가데이터처 통계분류포털 (KSSC)
sources.title_en: National Data Office Statistical Classification Portal
sources.reliability_notes: Public portal to verify occupation/industry lists, named by the press release as the place to confirm 직종·업종. Used as the 'official confirmation' destination in the UI.
sources.limitations: Portal content is the source of truth; this analyzer is a finder, not a substitute.

sources.title: 출입국관리법 시행규칙 제47조·제49조의2 (외국인 취업정보 신고)
sources.title_en: Enforcement Rules of the Immigration Control Act, Arts. 47 & 49-2
sources.reliability_notes: Legal basis for the employment-information reporting obligation. Binding text to confirm penalties and exact obligation scope.
sources.limitations: Amendments possible; confirm current text on law.go.kr.

sources.title: 문신사법(타투업법)
sources.reliability_notes: 국회 본회의 통과 2025-09-25, 시행 예정 2027-10-29. Used for the legally-sensitive tattoo caution; there is no dedicated KSCO8/KSIC11 tattoo code.
sources.limitations: Pre-enforcement; foreigner eligibility and license requirements must be confirmed on law.go.kr and with the competent immigration office.

sources.title: 이민자 체류·취업 통계 (커버리지/테스트 우선순위 보조)
sources.title_en: Immigrant residence/employment statistics (coverage & test prioritization only)
sources.reliability_notes: Used ONLY to prioritize which sectors get the most test coverage (E-8 농어업, E-9 제조/건설/서비스, E-10 선원, H-2 현장·서비스). NEVER used as classification truth.
sources.limitations: Aggregate counts say nothing about which occupation/industry code an individual should report.
